resources.string: Only an encrypted copy of your vault file is sent: never your master password, your keys or the decrypted content.
It goes only to the service you choose.
Only to keep backup copies and, later, to sync between your devices.
KeyNexa has no servers of its own and sends no statistics.
Old copies may still hold old passwords, so their number is limited.
To stop using it, use “Disconnect and delete”: it deletes the credentials on this device. Copies already uploaded are deleted from the service itself.
There is also a build with no network access at all.
Cloud copies: no service configured yet (setup arrives in the next version).
The cloud credentials stored on this device will be deleted. Copies already uploaded stay in the service; delete them there.
